name: Soulfang, Amon's Wolf

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Constant Companion
traits.details: Soulfang cannot target Amon with an attack. If forced to do so, Soulfang instead loses the action he was using to make the attack.

powers.name: Freeze Blood and Soul
powers.trigger: An enemy is bloodied after being hit by Soulfang’s attack.

effect.description: The triggering enemy is petrified (save ends) as solid ice.

failedSavingThrows.name: Each Failed Saving Throw
failedSavingThrows.description: The enemy loses 1 healing surge. If the enemy has no healing surge to lose, it dies and the petrification becomes permanent.
